entries.title: Psalms 104:1
segments: ¶Bless Jehovah, O my soul! Jehovah my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with majesty and splendour;

entries.title: Psalms 104:2
segments: Covering thyself with light as with a garment, stretching out the heavens like a tent-curtain; --

entries.title: Psalms 104:3
segments: Who layeth the beams of his upper chambers in the waters, who maketh clouds his chariot, who walketh upon the wings of the wind;

entries.title: Psalms 104:4
segments: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flame of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 104:5
segments: He laid the earth upon its foundations: it shall not be removed for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 104:6
segments: Thou hadst covered it with the deep, as with a vesture; the waters stood above the mountains:

entries.title: Psalms 104:7
segments: At thy rebuke they fled, at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away; --

entries.title: Psalms 104:8
segments: The mountains rose, the valleys sank, unto the place which thou hadst founded for them; --

entries.title: Psalms 104:9
segments: Thou hast set a bound which they may not pass over, that they turn not again to cover the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:10
segments: ¶He sendeth the springs into the valleys: they run among the mountains;

entries.title: Psalms 104:11
segments: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild asses quench their thirst.

entries.title: Psalms 104:12
segments: The birds of heaven dwell by them; they give forth their voice from among the branches.

entries.title: Psalms 104:13
segments: He watereth the mountains from his upper-chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

entries.title: Psalms 104:14
segments: He maketh the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man; bringing forth bread out of the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 104:15
segments: And wine which gladdeneth the heart of man; making [his] face shine with oil; and with bread he strengtheneth man's heart.

entries.title: Psalms 104:16
segments: The trees of Jehovah are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted,

entries.title: Psalms 104:17
segments: Where the birds make their nests; [as for] the stork, the fir trees are her house.

entries.title: Psalms 104:18
segments: The high mountains are for the wild goats; the cliffs, a refuge for the rock-badgers.

entries.title: Psalms 104:19
segments: ¶He made the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth its going down.

entries.title: Psalms 104:20
segments: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth:

entries.title: Psalms 104:21
segments: The young lions roar after the prey, and to seek their food from *God.

entries.title: Psalms 104:22
segments: The sun ariseth, they retreat, and lay them down in their dens.

entries.title: Psalms 104:23
segments: Man goeth forth unto his work, and to his labour until the evening.

entries.title: Psalms 104:24
segments: How manifold are thy works, O Jehovah! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

entries.title: Psalms 104:25
segments: Yonder is the great and wide sea: therein are moving things innumerable, living creatures small and great.

entries.title: Psalms 104:26
segments: There go the ships; [there] that leviathan, which thou hast formed to play therein.

entries.title: Psalms 104:27
segments: These all look unto thee, that thou mayest give their food in its season:

entries.title: Psalms 104:28
segments: That thou givest unto them, they gather; thou openest thy hand, they are filled with good.

entries.title: Psalms 104:29
segments: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; thou takest away their breath, they expire and return to their dust.

entries.title: Psalms 104:30
segments: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created, and thou renewest the face of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 104:31
segments: ¶The glory of Jehovah will endure for ever; Jehovah will rejoice in his works.

entries.title: Psalms 104:32
segments: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; he toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

entries.title: Psalms 104:33
segments: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live; I will sing psalms to my God while I have my being.

entries.title: Psalms 104:34
segments: My meditation shall be pleasant unto him; I will rejoice in Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 104:35
segments: Sinners shall be consumed out of the earth, and the wicked shall be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Hallelujah!
